sloka: अर्चयामास तं देवं भृगुः शापेन पीडितः ।तपसाराधितो देवो ह्यब्रवीद्भक्तवत्सलः ।लोकानां संहितार्थं तु तं शापं ग्राह्यमुक्तवान् ।। ७.५१.१९ ॥
transliteration: arcayāmāsa taṁ devaṁ bhṛguḥ śāpena pīḍitaḥ ।tapasārādhito devo hyabravīdbhaktavatsalaḥ ।lokānāṁ saṁhitārthaṁ tu taṁ śāpaṁ grāhyamuktavān ।। 7.51.19 ॥

translations.english: The greatly effulgent one, who was cursed by Bhrigu in a previous birth, has indeed come here to be your son, O best among kings.
